hypothesis: Point-level continuity of actual longitudinal infrastructure, rather than occupancy of a coarse cross-section cell, can explain the measured interior returns responsible for empty-tunnel alarms without treating compact intrusions as infrastructure.
label_provenance: Organizer statement reported in issue 21: only the first source recording contains a person; the other issued tunnels are empty. This is not exhaustive surface annotation.
nonblind_warning: The extended replay and all six original recordings have already been inspected during earlier work; evaluation is fixed before this candidate, not a blind holdout. New_data is one continuous recording with acquisition gaps, not 221 independent recordings.
episode_rule: Per recording, coalesce confirmed obstacle frames when successive confirmed frames are at most 0.5 seconds apart in measurement timestamps and there is no acquisition gap >0.5 seconds between them; ignore track ID. Cut at every gap; do not count frames as independent episodes.
criterion: Accept only if confirmed false-alarm episodes per actual evaluated minute fall on the full evaluation recording, person presence remains 36/36 with separately reported localization, tracking and adjacent relation, and neither unresolved/unknown duration nor hybrid-synthetic object/hazard misses increase. Report supported range and runtime. No change to reference contour or confirmation thresholds.
